method: Verifier and adversarial falsifier passes run this cycle by the drafting agent, applying policy/verification.md §5 (business claim type, >=2 independent Tier<=2 sources required) and the wire-exclusive check against the swarm of outlets covering the same announcement.
origin_items: Surfaced in cycle 3's triage (2026-08-03 23:50-23:56 UTC) via techmeme.json; dedup-checked clean at that point. Opened for full verification this cycle (cycle 4).

claims.text: Zenity raised a $125 million Series C round led by Norwest Venture Partners, announced 3 August 2026, taking its total funding to about $185 million
claims.reasoning: Confirmed via two independent sources with distinct, non-overlapping quotes: CTech/Calcalist (Kliger quote on technical differentiation, total-funding figure, revenue detail) and Fortune (separate Kliger quote on agent monitoring, SoftBank CISO Tadashi Iida quote). Both independently report the same $125M/Norwest/~$185M-total figures with no discrepancy -- satisfies the >=2 independent sources bar. A BusinessWire press-release fetch was attempted but timed out; not used as a source, not needed given the two independent outlets already meet the bar.

claims.text: New investors SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Hitachi Ventures, and LG Technology Ventures joined the round, alongside returning investors including Qumra Capital, Vertex Ventures, Third Point Ventures, DTCP, and Intel Capital
claims.reasoning: Investor list consistent across both independent sources; Fortune additionally carries an on-record quote from SoftBank's own CISO confirming SoftBank's participation independent of the company's framing.

claims.text: Zenity says annual revenue has tripled in each of the past two years and is on track to triple again this year
claims.reasoning: Company-reported figure via CTech, not independently audited; presented in the article as a company claim. Only one of the two sources carries this specific figure (Fortune does not disclose revenue), so evidence is [1] only for this claim.

claims.text: Zenity plans to use the funds to expand its platform, grow its Zenity Labs research division, and accelerate international expansion in Europe and Asia-Pacific
claims.reasoning: Use-of-funds detail reported consistently by both independent sources.

falsifier_notes: Overall verdict: CLEAR TO PUBLISH as confirmed. Adversarial search for 'Zenity funding denied OR disputed OR delayed Series C 2026' turned up no contradicting reports -- all results independently corroborate the $125M/Norwest/3 August 2026 figures. dedup-check returned zero matches (exit 0, empty matches array) -- no coincidental or genuine overlap with any existing article or ledger entry. Valuation was not disclosed by either source and is correctly omitted from the article rather than estimated.
